name: Windshear Hold
summary: Windshear Hold is a fortified Alliance settlement situated within the contested crags of the Stonetalon Mountains. Built using traditional night elf craftsmanship, the outpost serves as a central staging ground for diverse Alliance forces contending with nearby threats.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Crag
sections.body: Perched within the rugged heights of Windshear Crag, Windshear Hold provides the Alliance with a vital foothold in the heart of Stonetalon. Though rooted in night elven architecture and forest sensibilities, the hold gathers soldiers and travelers of all Alliance races under one banner. It acts as a defensive anchor against hostile encroachers and coordinates regional communication through its aerial courier networks.

faq.answer: It is an Alliance outpost situated within Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Constructed using night elf architectural designs, it houses members of multiple Alliance races and offers refuge for regional travelers.
The settlement belongs entirely to the Alliance. While night elf builders laid its foundations, it is garrisoned and utilized by various races of the faction cooperating in Stonetalon.

faq.q: What services are available at Windshear Hold?
faq.answer: Travelers can find shelter and lodging at the Fallowmere Inn. The hold also functions as a travel hub with flight networks connecting to outposts across the region such as Nijel's Point and Farwatcher's Glen.

faq.q: Where in the Stonetalon Mountains is it located?
faq.answer: The hold is positioned in Windshear Crag, a mountainous and contested portion of the Stonetalon Mountains often troubled by logging and territorial skirmishes.

angles.text: Windshear Hold serves as your vital redoubt in central Stonetalon, offering shelter at Fallowmere Inn and flight connections to northern bases like Nijel's Point.
Built from ancestral craft to defend the peaks of Kalimdor, this outpost integrates your sister races into guarding the sacred mountains.
